title: Hacker House Medellín sync gateway
description: The opto-sync reconciliation gateway (syncer.rs). It merges two JSON documents with array-merge-by-key on `id` and last-writer-wins on `updated_at`/`synced_at`, which is what makes the queued `create_reservation` operation in api.route-map.json safe to replay.

Health.doc: Built inline in the route closure with serde_json::json!.

base.doc: The document already held. Any JSON value; in practice an array of reservation records.

incoming.doc: The document to merge in. Any JSON value, of the same shape as `base`.

contract.doc: Constant `hhm_interfaces::Reservation` -- what the server claims it merges. Note that hhm-interfaces::Reservation (title/summary/space_name/starts_at/ends_at) is not the shape hhm-api actually serves (room_type/check_in/check_out/workspace_plan/notes); this string is a label, not a checked contract.

MergeError.doc: Returned with 422 when the two documents cannot be merged.

readyz.summary: Readiness probe. Answers 204 with an empty body, so there is no response type.

reconcile.summary: Merge two documents and return the result.

reconcile_api_alias.summary: The same handler, mounted a second time under /api. Kept because deployed callers use both prefixes.
